subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the documented failed A/B satisfy this issue’s explicit stop condition, or should another specific route-import hypothesis be measured?
rationale: The experiment followed the issue’s acceptance criteria and produced a clean no-go, but deciding whether that result completes the repository-member-authored investigation or warrants further performance work requires human prioritization.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the measured failed extraction as completion of this bounded investigation and close the issue with the results preserved for future performance work.

options.title: Define another hypothesis
options.body: Keep the issue open only after naming a specific import boundary, current-main baseline, material reduction threshold, and browser waterfall validation plan.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the measured failed extraction as completion of this bounded investigation and close the issue with the results preserved for future performance work.
